title: Older Americans Month Community BINGO Challenge
source_title: Talawanda High School | Smore Newsletters for Education

blocks.content: Every May, Older Americans Month recognizes the contributions of older adults, highlights aging trends, and reaffirms commitments to serve our older community members. The 2026 theme is “Champion Your Health”.Throughout the month of May, Oxford Seniors, Age-Friendly Oxford, and the Coalition for a Healthy Community, Oxford Area are partnering to highlight and offer programming focused on promoting physical, mental, and emotional health and well-being at all ages.You can participate by playing “Community BINGO” with us! It’s as easy as 1, 2, 3!1) Print your own or pick up a Community Bingo card at any of the following locations:Oxford Seniors, 922 Tollgate Dr., OxfordOxford Lane Library, 441 S. Locust St.The Knolls of Oxford, Clubhouse or Front DeskScripps Gerontology Center, 396 Upham Hall, on campus2) Every time you do something listed on the card, mark it off. The goal is to get “BINGO” as many times as possible. A “BINGO” is marking off any 5 squares in a straight line – either vertically, horizontally, or diagonally.3) Bring your completed BINGO card to the Intergenerational BINGO Party on Sun. May 31 from 3:00 – 5:00 p.m. at Oxford Seniors for prizes, snacks, and FUN!

summary: **Older Americans Month** (May 2026, theme: "Champion Your Health") features a **Community BINGO** challenge promoting health and well-being. Pick up BINGO cards at **Oxford Seniors** (922 Tollgate Dr.), **Oxford Lane Library** (441 S. Locust St.), **The Knolls of Oxford**, or **Scripps Gerontology Center** (396 Upham Hall). Complete activities on the card throughout May, then bring your card to the **Intergenerational BINGO Party on Sunday, May 31, 3:00-5:00 PM at Oxford Seniors** for prizes and snacks.

LIONS CLUB EYEGLASS COLLECTION

The Oxford Lions Club Sight Saving Committee is collecting used eyeglasses, sunglasses as well as cases! These glasses and cases are donated all over the world to children who are in need. The lenses and frames from the donated glasses are modified to meet individual children's eye needs. Every year, Oxford Lions Club collects and sends 900-plus pairs of glasses to children in need!Please send any glasses donations to Betsy Beaton (Marshall Elementary School) or Shaunna Tafelski (Board Office) by mid-May We are happy to swing by and pick up glasses donations or they can be dropped off at Marshall or the Board Office. Thank you for supporting the Oxford Lions Club! Thanks!

Pick-up or drop-off available at Marshall Elementary or the Board Office.
